primary_work.title: Sanity Checking Causal Representation Learning on a Simple Real-World System

decision: NARROWED BEYOND EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED CRL RECOVERY — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: population identifiability alone is sufficient evidence for practical causal-factor recovery
language improving a failing or misspecified CRL baseline establishes joint identification
task success, prediction, probing, or shuffle gaps substitute for direct partition recovery
a synthetic-only gain establishes robustness to a physical observation mixing process
remaining_rq: After faithfully reproducing the strongest public non-language CRL baselines on synthetic assumptions and matched semi-synthetic or physical sanity checks, can an externally fixed preregistered language law eliminate a specifically characterized residual joint automorphism over raw-utterance equivalence and intervention-target partition rather than compensating for decoder mismatch, optimization failure, or finite-sample error?
new_requirement: pin and reproduce an official CRL baseline with decoder/mixing ablations, then demonstrate direct partition recovery on a preregistered residual countermodel pair
